summary: Glen Schofield, a veteran from Sledgehammer Games, expresses deep concern that Microsoft's acquisition of Call of Duty could lead to the franchise losing its unique identity and creative freedom, similar to what he believes happened with Halo and Gears of War. title: How F5 And SonicWall Revealed The Fragility Of The Software Supply Chain - Forrester
summary: This Forrester article discusses how recent breaches at F5 and SonicWall exposed the fragility of the software supply chain, with software supply chain breaches accounting for 30% of external attacks in 2025. It highlights the risks associated with centralized cloud management and the blind spots created by traditional third-party risk management. The article concludes with recommendations for security leaders to audit deployments, decentralize critical assets, enhance third-party risk management to include product-level assessments, make SBOMs mandatory, encrypt backups with customer-controlled keys, enable operational resilience, and conduct thorough detection and threat hunting for anomalous activities.
